abstract: We attempted to determine the efficacy of basic fetoprotein as a marker in testicular cancer. The levels of serum basic fetoprotein were studied in 58 patients (31 with seminoma and 27 with nonseminoma). Elevated levels were observed in 22 seminoma (71 per cent) and 15 nonseminoma (56 per cent) patients, while the levels of other markers (beta-subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin, alpha-fetoprotein and lactic dehydrogenase) remained normal in 6 seminoma (19 per cent) and 2 nonseminoma (7 per cent) patients. The levels of basic fetoprotein changed in relation to the clinical courses and they elevated again in 3 of 4 patients with recurrence. The concentration of basic fetoprotein in testicular cancer tissue was significantly higher than in the normal testis. Histological localization of basic fetoprotein in testicular cancer tissue was demonstrated immunohistochemically. Thus, basic fetoprotein was considered to be a useful serum marker for testicular cancer.
abstract_ja: 精巣がんにおける血清マーカーとしてのbasic fetoprotein の有用性を検討した。精巣がん58例(セミノーマ31例、非セミノーマ27例)で血清basic fetoprotein値を測定した。basic fetoprotein値の上昇は、セミノーマ22例(71%)、非セミノーマ15例(56%)でみられた。一方、他のマーカー(β-hCG、AFP、LDH)は、セミノーマ6例(19%)と非セミノーマ2例(7%)で正常であった。basic fetoprotein値は臨床経過に伴って変化し、再発した4例中3例で再上昇した。精巣がん組織中のbasic fetoprotein濃度は正常精巣より有意に高かった。精巣がん組織におけるbasic fetoprotein の局在は免疫組織化学的に示された。したがって、basic fetoprotein は精巣がんの有用な血清マーカーと考えられた。
